title.zh: CZ回应BNB Chain新L1计划：多条链，一种币
title.en: CZ回应BNB Chain新L1计划：多条链，一种币

current_state.zh: CZ已背书BNB Chain新L1计划：该L1将与BSC并存，通过原生跨链桥连接，不发行独立代币，继续使用BNB作为Gas、质押和治理资产；名称待定，已运行内部多验证者开发网，官方目标为2026年底测试网、2027年初主网。
current_state.en: CZ has endorsed BNB Chain's new L1 plan: the L1 will coexist with BSC, connect via a native bridge, issue no separate token, and continue using BNB for gas, staking and governance; its name is TBD, an internal multi-validator devnet is already running, and the official target is testnet in late 2026 and mainnet in early 2027.

updates.title_zh: CZ回应BNB Chain新L1计划：多条链，一种币
updates.title_en: CZ回应BNB Chain新L1计划：多条链，一种币
updates.what_changed_zh: BNB Chain 正在开发一条新的高性能 EVM 兼容 L1，具备亚秒级最终性、原生账户抽象、交易预确认、多通道容量预留和链上隐私池，CZ 将该策略概括为“多条链，一个币”。
updates.what_changed_en: BNB Chain is developing a new high-performance EVM-compatible L1 with sub-second finality, native account abstraction, transaction preconfirmations, multi-channel capacity reservation, and an on-chain privacy pool, with CZ framing the strategy as 'multiple chains, one coin.'
